description: This Java class, MySQLQueryService, provides methods to interact with a MySQL database, such as checking if a table exists, retrieving table columns, and fetching table indexes. It implements the DatabaseQueryService interface and uses Spring's JdbcTemplate for database operations.

classes.name: MySQLQueryService
classes.description: A Spring component that provides methods to execute MySQL-specific queries such as checking table existence, retrieving columns, and indexes.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if the current database type is MySQL.

methods.name: isTablePresent
methods.description: Determines if a specific table exists in the database by executing a SHOW TABLES LIKE query.

methods.name: getTableColumns
methods.description: Fetches column definitions for a given table from the INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS table.

methods.name: getTableIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index details for a specified table from the INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATISTICS table.
